name: Feed grid planning
summary: The practice of planning the order of posts so that the profile grid reads as one board.
how: Preview the next 9 posts in a 3-column grid before posting.
Fix one preset, one palette and one crop ratio.
Repeat a rhythm of image types in rows of 3.
Check the grid after each post.

origin.note: Scheduling apps add a grid preview of the Instagram profile.

adoptions.via: Brand and creator profiles plan the grid as one board with a repeat rhythm.
